nodes.label: Technical Case Study: Job Radar Scoring Engine
nodes.author: Taylan Özgür Özdemir
nodes.norm_label: technical case study: job radar scoring engine
nodes.rationale: Showcases refactored scoring engine and Clean Code practices for Junior Software Engineer role at Sezzle.

nodes.label: Technical Case Study PDF: Job Radar Scoring Engine
nodes.author: Taylan Özgür Özdemir
nodes.norm_label: technical case study pdf: job radar scoring engine

nodes.label: NLP-Powered Job Scoring
nodes.rationale: Uses TF-IDF vectorization and regex pattern matching to evaluate job postings by tech stack, location, and seniority.

nodes.label: Job Radar Spreadsheet Schema
nodes.rationale: Schema comprising Başlık, Firma, Alan, Lokasyon, Level, Skor, Link, Tarih, and Durum columns.

nodes.label: Weighted Scoring Formula
nodes.rationale: Formula: Total = (Field * 0.3) + (Location * 0.4) + (Level * 0.3), heavily prioritizing Ankara/Remote junior game development positions.

nodes.label: Clean Code Engineering Decisions
nodes.rationale: Emphasizes runtime validation via Pydantic, service encapsulation for testability, and Pytest coverage for regression prevention.

nodes.label: Domain Modeling Specification
nodes.rationale: Defines JobField, JobLocation, JobLevel enums, Job raw model, and ScoredJob model with field validators.

nodes.label: Quality Assurance & Unit Testing Showcase
nodes.rationale: Unit test suite with Pytest validating standard categorization, restriction enforcement, and seniority regex.

nodes.label: Scoring Service Architecture Showcase
nodes.rationale: Encapsulates restriction checks, language detection, fast path keyword matching, NLP context inference, and seniority detection.

nodes.label: Job Application Presentation Guide
nodes.rationale: Practical guide for presenting the Clean Code Showcase and engineering decisions to tech recruiters at Sezzle and Fintech firms.

nodes.label: Multi-Source Job Aggregation
nodes.rationale: Aggregates job listings across LinkedIn, JSearch API, RSS feeds, and Kariyer.net to provide wide coverage.

nodes.label: Job Radar Development Roadmap
nodes.rationale: Roadmap detailing progression from v0.7 application accelerators to v1.0 autonomous assistant.

nodes.label: Smart Google Sheets Integration
nodes.rationale: Synchronizes processed job opportunities with Google Sheets featuring conditional formatting, status-based row coloring, and smart dropdown chips.
